title: encrypt.rs: AES-256-CBC when any recipient is P-384 is correct security-level matching
description: encrypt() upgrades the content encryption key from AES-128-CBC to AES-256-CBC when any recipient uses P-384. The comment explains P-384 provides ~192-bit security and pairing with AES-128 would be a mismatch. This is correct: NIST SP 800-57 Table 2 places P-384 at the 192-bit security level. A future contributor might simplify to always use AES-128-CBC (smaller output, simpler code). That would create a security-level mismatch for P-384 recipients, which is a cryptographic protocol violation. The upgrade logic must stay.
